title: What's Included with the VIP Add-Ons Club Subscription
text:
## What's Included with the VIP Add-Ons Club Subscription
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044042
If you've joined the VIP Add-Ons Club - CONGRATULATIONS! Your website now has access to all available add-ons. It's the best way to automate tasks, boost revenue, rank better, increase sign ups and more!
Keep in mind, if you have multiple websites, each website needs to have it's own VIP Add-Ons Club Subscription. If you would like to have the VIP Add-Ons Club on multiple websites, please connect with our success team to inquire about multi-site discounts.

## Important Notes
SSL Certificates can be added to your website after you've connected your live domain name. This can be installed by you at anytime.
The 500+ Essential Business Categories are only installed upon request. This is because many websites have their own category structure and do not need this add-on.
This is because many websites have their own category structure and do not need this add-on.
You'll have access to any add-ons released in the future for websites that are subscribed to the VIP Add-Ons Club.
Some add-ons do require basic setup and configuration, such as the One-Click Social Login and Facebook Website Chat add-ons. Please check the documentation links below for information on enabling or disabling any add-ons.
Please check the documentation links below for information on enabling or disabling any add-ons.
If you ever have questions about your add-ons or need help, feel free to email addons@brilliantdirectories.com for assistance.
